record.name: Podio
record.one_liner: Podio provides a public REST-based programmatic interface supporting OAuth2 authentication for building applications and integrations.

auth.notes: Supports server-side, client-side, username & password, and app authentication flows returning access tokens sent via the Authorization header.

access.notes: Developers can grab an API key directly from their account settings page.

api_surface.notes: The API includes comprehensive core areas such as Applications, Items, Tasks, and Hooks.

mcp.notes: Reported value was discarded: no support offered.

evidence.claim: The API uses OAuth2 for authentication
evidence.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.

evidence.claim: Developers can obtain an API key from account settings
evidence.quote: grab an API key for each app you want to build from your account settings page.
If you want to build event-driven applications, you have the ability to register webhooks in your Podio apps.

evidence.claim: The API provides several language SDK wrappers
evidence.quote: We currently provide wrappers for PHP, .NET, Ruby, Java, Python, Android and Objective-C which make working with common API operations very simple.
